hoodie.title: Premium organic cotton hoodies, oversized fit
hoodie.description: Oversized 330 gsm hoodie in certified organic cotton, embroidered logo, brushed inside, 6 pastel and neutral colours. French brand, free shipping from €80.
hoodie.heading: Hoodies
hoodie.intro: A premium hoodie made for every day: 330 gsm fleece in certified organic cotton, an oversized cut that sits just right, round drawcords, a KODA logo that is embroidered, never printed. Six colours, from sky blue to navy.
hoodie.detailTitle: Which hoodie size should I pick?
hoodie.detail: The fit is oversized: take your usual size for a roomy look, one size down for a closer fit. Model 1m75 wears S, 1m85 wears M.

sweat.title: Oversized crew-neck sweatshirts in organic cotton
sweat.description: Oversized crew-neck sweatshirt, 300 gsm, cotton and certified recycled polyester, drop shoulders, brushed inside, 4 colours. French brand, free shipping from €80.
sweat.heading: Sweatshirts
sweat.intro: The KODA oversized sweatshirt: crew neck, drop shoulders, ribbed hem and cuffs, brushed inside for softness. A 300 gsm fleece that keeps its shape wash after wash. Unisex, four colours.
sweat.detailTitle: Which sweatshirt size should I pick?
sweat.detail: Roomy by design: your usual size gives the intended oversized look. Model 1m75 wears S, 1m85 wears M.

tee.title: Premium 180 gsm tees, slightly oversized
tee.description: Unisex 180 gsm tee, slightly oversized fit, embroidered logo, 5 pastel colours and black. French brand, free shipping from €80.
tee.heading: Tees
tee.intro: A thick, soft 180 gsm tee with a slightly oversized cut that shapes the silhouette without floating. KODA logo embroidered on the chest. Five colours: pastel green, sky blue, mauve, pink, black.
tee.detailTitle: Which tee size should I pick?
tee.detail: Unisex sizing, slightly oversized: go one size down from your usual size for a closer fit. Model 1m75 wears S, 1m85 wears M.
